messages:
acme-qa: Hey @support — after today's canary (v1.4.3) our invoice-summary job started dropping the 'amount_due' line when the placeholder order is changed slightly. Worked before the rollout. Repro + minimal request below.

maya-support: Thanks — can you paste the request_id and a minimal prompt example? Also any logs or the response body would help.

acme-qa: request_id: r-0a9f2b3c
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-jax-2.3","prompt_template":"Invoice:\n{{customer_name}}\nAmount: {{amount_due}}\nNotes: {{notes}}","inputs":{"customer_name":"ACME","notes":"late fee applied","amount_due":"$123.45"}}'

Response (truncated field):
{
  "request_id": "r-0a9f2b3c",
  "output": "Invoice:\nACME\nAmount:\nNotes: late fee applied"
}
Also saw a ~150ms extra latency spike on that call compared to yesterday.

liam-runtime: @acme-qa thanks. Two quick q's: did the model variant change (e.g., fallback to a lower-precision quantized variant)? can you share the exact model name from the request? Also trying: `rbxctl traces get r-0a9f2b3c` might show kernel selection/variant.

acme-qa: Model header in our call shows `redwood/gpt-jax-2.3@v2026-11-02` — we didn't request any variant. Re-ran locally and got same strip when we swap placeholders order (amount_due after notes). Example that breaks: 
```
Prompt template A:
Invoice:
{{customer_name}}
Amount: {{amount_due}}
Notes: {{notes}}

Prompt template B (swapped):
Invoice:
{{customer_name}}
Notes: {{notes}}
Amount: {{amount_due}}
```
A -> OK, B -> amount missing.

opsbot: :money_with_wings: FYI billing-alert: anomalous usage spike correlated with r-0a9f2b3c window (2030011140-2030011180). Investigating.

sara-prod: @maya-support @liam-runtime can we confirm whether canary included any prompt-serialization changes? If it's a rollout regression we may need an immediate canary pause/rollback. :eyes: 

maya-support: I reproduced locally with the same model and `quantize: q4_0` config. When I inspect tokens before generation the token sequence for template B includes an extra split token around `Amount:` which seems to push the placeholder mapping off by one during prefix caching. Quick repro snippet: 
```
// simplified pseudocode
serializePrompt(templateB, inputs) -> tokenIds = [101, 234, 999, ...]
// placeholder slot for amount_due ends up at token index 27 instead of 25
```
Output shows the placeholder replaced with empty string.

liam-runtime: That aligns with a recent change in the tokenization normalization path we shipped in v1.4.3 (small optimization to dedupe whitespace tokens for batch packing). Looks like it interacts badly with placeholder offsets + prefix/KV cache. I'm going to bisect the canary commits. If we confirm, immediate hotfix is to revert the normalization or adjust placeholder anchoring.

maya-support: Escalating to eng-runtime. Marking as sev=P2 for now. Adding repro steps and request_id into the tracker. @acme-qa really appreciate the quick repro. We'll follow up with a timeline. :thumbsup:
